name: Van Sales Summary by Route
query:
SELECT
  fvs.route as "Route:Link/FMCG Route Beat Plan:150",
  fvs.salesperson as "Salesperson:Link/Employee:150",
  fvs.date as "Date:Date:100",
  fvs.total_amount as "Total Amount:Currency:130",
  fvs.payment_mode as "Payment Mode:Data:100"
FROM `tabFMCG Van Sales Entry` fvs
WHERE fvs.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY fvs.date DESC
